name: Bodyweight Sumo Squat
steps: Stand tall with your feet planted significantly wider than shoulder width, toes turned out roughly 45 degrees, and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Brace your core, lift your chest, and keep your weight evenly distributed across both whole feet.
Bend your knees and hips smoothly to lower straight down until your thighs reach at least parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand tall again and squeeze your glutes and inner thighs at the top.
tips: Track your knees outward directly over your angled toes so they never collapse inward.
Keep your torso upright rather than leaning excessively forward as you squat down.
